name_resolution.rationale: TaiCOL and Tai2 returned no exact species record. Kew POWO explicitly treats Picea excelsa as a synonym of Picea abies var. abies. A Taiwan Forestry Research Institute public bulletin directly prints Picea Abies (P. excelsa) with 挪威雲杉, and National Taiwan University public seed resources pair Picea abies with 歐洲雲杉. No Taiwan occurrence is asserted.
